sentences.en: Pathology examination showed inflammation compatible with a mycotic aneurysm, although cultures of the resected aneurysm had no growth.

sentences.en: Although a ruptured mycotic aortic aneurysm is frequently fatal, aggressive surgical treatment may save the patient's life.

sentences.en: Objective To discuss the hospital-acquired mycotic infection, its spread condition, risk factor, and related healing and prognostic conditions.
